Bonusly is an employee recognition software designed to facilitate peer-to-peer recognition and reward within organizations. The software enables employees to give each other points for contributions, which can be redeemed for a variety of rewards. It offers features such as integration with communication tools, real-time recognition, detailed analytics, and customizable reward catalogs. Bonusly is used by organizations to support employee engagement, promote workplace collaboration, and reinforce company values.
